profile.text: R&V Model witchcraft operation platform PhonoR-0, Rhodes Island's first and only intelligent operation platform equipped with a Banshee incantation Arts device. Unlike the customized Raythean Industries models, she was born from the unbreakable rapport between our most skilled operators and the Banshees. Compared to other wheeled operation platforms, the witchcraft-based components in her operating mechanisms, drive system, and core more closely resemble a mobile altar. Despite being the product of both cutting-edge technology and Sarkaz witchcraft, her basic specs are unimpressive, but she is easy to deploy and able to provide mid-mission assistance to operators. She currently participates in combat missions as a Supporter Operator.
